financial-management.title: Financial Management System
financial-management.challenge: The client relied on a legacy, on-premise system that was slow, prone to errors, and lacked real-time reporting capabilities. They needed a secure, modern, and cloud-native solution to streamline their financial operations and scale with their growing user base.
financial-management.solution: We designed and developed a comprehensive financial dashboard featuring real-time data visualization, automated reporting, and secure role-based access controls. The architecture leveraged Next.js for the frontend and a scalable microservices backend.
financial-management.results: The new system reduced data processing time by 40%, eliminated manual reporting errors, and provided executives with immediate insights into financial health.

ecommerce-dashboard.title: E-Commerce Dashboard
ecommerce-dashboard.challenge: Managing inventory, tracking orders, and analyzing sales across multiple storefronts was a manual, disjointed process. The client required a centralized hub to monitor their entire e-commerce ecosystem in real time.
ecommerce-dashboard.solution: We built a customized analytics and management dashboard that integrated seamlessly with their existing Shopify and WooCommerce stores. It featured advanced filtering, sales forecasting algorithms, and intuitive charts.
ecommerce-dashboard.results: The centralized dashboard improved inventory turnover by 25% and saved the operations team over 15 hours a week in manual tracking.

enterprise-logistics.title: Enterprise Logistics & Fleet Portal
enterprise-logistics.challenge: Dispatch operators struggled with fragmented legacy tracking tools, lack of live telemetry, and unpredictable delivery ETAs, leading to higher fuel overheads and delivery delays across over 500 regional freight vehicles.
enterprise-logistics.solution: We engineered a cross-platform mobile driver application paired with a centralized cloud dispatch control center. Features include real-time GPS telemetry, automated dynamic route calculation, and automated client shipment status alerts.
enterprise-logistics.results: Decreased fleet fuel consumption by 18%, lowered average delivery route delays by 35%, and provided full operational transparency to supply chain managers.

healthcare-platform.title: Healthcare Telemedicine Platform
healthcare-platform.challenge: Patients faced long hospital waiting times for routine consultations, while practitioners needed a HIPAA-compliant virtual consultation tool connected seamlessly to electronic medical records without cumbersome installations.
healthcare-platform.solution: We built an end-to-end telemedicine web and mobile ecosystem featuring encrypted WebRTC video visits, automated appointment scheduling, digital e-prescriptions, and secure FHIR-compliant electronic health record synchronization.
healthcare-platform.results: Handled over 12,000 monthly virtual patient visits with a 99.98% platform uptime, reducing clinic in-person congestion by 45%.

hassan_rohz.title: Hassan Rohz
hassan_rohz.overviewP1: Our CEO embodies the essence of visionary leadership and the spirit of entrepreneurial tenacity. With a profound understanding of the intricate dance between management and business building, he has consistently demonstrated the unique ability to transform raw ideas into flourishing enterprises. His journey is a testament to the power of resilience, foresight, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.
hassan_rohz.overviewP2: His experiences are not just a chronicle of building businesses, but of nurturing dreams and creating legacies. A beacon for aspiring entrepreneurs, our CEO's approach to leadership is holistic, emphasizing both innovation and sustainability. It's under his guidance that we at Gredoz find the inspiration to constantly push boundaries, ensuring that we not only meet but exceed the expectations of our clients and partners.
hassan_rohz.quote: Building enduring technology requires more than code — it demands unwavering discipline, sustainable vision, and cultivating teams that thrive on solving hard problems.

harem_kerkuky.title: Harem Kerkuky

He understands that the success of any project hinges on the seamless collaboration of diverse skill sets. majeed_omar.title: Majeed Omar
majeed_omar.overviewP1: Majeed Omar emerges as a beacon of excellence, illuminating the path to technological innovation and finesse. His designation as a 'full-stack developer' barely scratches the surface of his multifaceted expertise. Majeed's prowess extends far beyond mere titles, encapsulated best by his adeptness at seamlessly melding the worlds of frontend and backend development, creating harmonious and efficient digital ecosystems.

He perceives it not just as a mechanical task of coding but as an art form, where technology meets creativity, resulting in solutions that are not only functional but also transformative. mustafa_abdo.title: Mustafa Abdo
mustafa_abdo.overviewP1: Mustafa Abdo leads artificial intelligence and machine learning engineering at Gredoz. Specializing in advanced predictive modeling, natural language processing, and deep neural network integration, he bridges frontier AI algorithms with robust software infrastructure.

Each website or application he crafts tells a story, guiding users through a seamless journey while ensuring optimal performance and responsiveness. In the ever-evolving domain of web development, having Yahya at the helm of our frontend endeavors instills a deep-seated confidence. We're not just delivering web solutions; with Yahya's expertise, we're crafting digital experiences.

Faq.title: Frequently Asked <italic>Questions</italic>
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our engineering standards, legal guarantees, and collaboration workflows.
Faq.q1: Who owns the intellectual property (IP) and source code?
Faq.a1: You own 100% of all intellectual property, source code, design assets, and database schemas from day one. Upon project completion and milestone releases, all repositories and assets are fully transferred to your accounts with zero vendor lock-in.
Faq.q2: How do you manage communication and time zones from Erbil?
Faq.a2: Our Erbil headquarters operates in the GMT+3 time zone, providing natural business-hour alignment with Europe, the Middle East (GCC), and substantial working-hours overlap with the Americas. We integrate directly into your company's communication channels (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, GitHub) with daily async updates and bi-weekly sprint demos.
Faq.q3: What are your typical project delivery timelines?
Faq.a3: Focused platforms and MVPs typically reach production within 6 to 10 weeks. Comprehensive enterprise software suites and cloud transformations generally span 3 to 6 months, organized into transparent two-week agile sprints with demonstrable working software at each stage.
Faq.q4: Can you collaborate with our existing internal tech team or legacy codebase?
Faq.a4: Absolutely. We frequently operate as an embedded engineering pod working alongside existing in-house developers, or take on phased refactoring of legacy systems with zero operational disruption to existing users and databases.
Faq.q5: What security standards and data confidentiality protections do you enforce?
Faq.a5: We enforce strict mutual enterprise NDAs before any technical exploration begins. All code adheres to OWASP security guidelines, role-based access control (RBAC), end-to-end data encryption, and automated vulnerability scanning in our CI/CD pipelines.
Faq.q6: What happens after product launch? Do you provide ongoing maintenance and SLAs?
Faq.a6: Yes, we provide structured Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with defined response windows, 24/7 infrastructure telemetry monitoring, automated backups, continuous dependency updates, and dedicated engineering support packages.
